name: Group Supply Of Goats And Sheep
benefit:
1. Under this scheme, a group of 10 goats and 1 buck are provided to tribal beneficiaries on 50 percent subsidy. The price of the group is decided according to the prevailing rates of NABARD.
• 2. Supply of goat Units:- Under this scheme To increase the income source& to create employment in tribal areas to farmers/ beneficiaries. The goatunits are provided to them. In year 2018-19 under this scheme totalallocation of Rs. 369.22 lakhs has been proposed.
eligibility_rules: Beneficiary should belong to Scheduled Tribe.
Beneficiary should be below poverty line.
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline Connect with Group Development Officer, Group Development Officer under Panchayat Samiti / and Zilla Parishad
